text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia. The combination of bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, and an abdominal X-ray showing dilated bowel segments with absent gas in the rectum is highly suggestive of a proximal intestinal obstruction, most likely duodenal atresia. I recommend REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound to confirm the finding and rule out other causes like malrotation.
